metadata.title: Security Assessment Results – Trusted Cloud (Microsoft Entra ID)
metadata.remarks: Trusted-Cloud assessment identifying contextual data residency and sovereignty risk for identity-related PII stored by Microsoft Entra ID, in light of emerging Canadian digital sovereignty policy (2025–2026).

findings.title: Identity-Related PII Hosted Under Foreign Jurisdiction
findings.description: Microsoft Entra ID stores identity-related personal information (e.g., usernames, alternate email addresses, phone numbers for MFA and recovery, device identifiers, and authentication metadata). Tenant identity data is geo-located in North America with instances hosted in the United States and operated by a U.S.-owned provider, making such data subject to U.S. jurisdiction. Emerging Canadian digital sovereignty policy (2025–2026) emphasizes sovereign control over sensitive data beyond mere residency, creating forward-looking compliance and procurement risk for certain contexts.

associated-risk.title: Jurisdictional Control over Identity PII
associated-risk.description: Foreign jurisdiction over identity-related PII may become misaligned with Canadian federal procurement rules and sector-specific requirements for protected or critical contexts, even where data is adequately secured and disclosed.

remediations.title: Manage Identity PII Sovereignty through Governance and Contextual Controls
remediations.description: Address jurisdictional and residency risk through policy, classification, and planning measures rather than technical remediation of the platform.

tasks.title: Conduct PIAs and Identity Data Classification
tasks.description: Perform and maintain Privacy Impact Assessments to document identity PII usage, residency, and jurisdictional exposure, and classify acceptable identity platforms by data sensitivity and use context.

tasks.title: Apply Contextual Use Restrictions
tasks.description: Define contexts and data classes (e.g., Protected B/C, critical infrastructure roles) where Entra ID usage may be restricted or require additional approvals due to sovereignty considerations.

tasks.title: Track Sovereign Identity Alternatives
tasks.description: Monitor and evaluate Canadian-sovereign or government-grade identity options and federation patterns to mitigate future procurement or regulatory constraints.
